title: Smiling Mother with Two Toddlers in Snow, 1958 Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A charming black-and-white family snapshot captured in April 1958, showing a smiling young mother crouching outdoors in a dusting of snow with her two young children. She wears a warm jacket and a tied headscarf (babushka), a popular and practical accessory for mid-century American women. On her lap sits an infant bundled in a hooded winter suit and mittens, while an older toddler boy stands beside her wearing a cap, toggle-front winter coat, and galoshes. They pose in front of a clapboard home with paned windows, quintessential of the post-WWII suburban Baby Boom era. The photograph features deckled edges and a front-margin processing stamp reading 'APR • 58'.
